title: Your marriage isn't falling apart because you love each other less...
paragraphs:
Your marriage isn't falling apart because you love each other less...
It may be because you've slowly stopped putting God first.
That's a hard truth.

Many couples still go to church.
Still wear their wedding rings.
Still say, "I love you."
But somewhere along the way...

Prayer became optional.
God's Word became occasional.
Busyness became the center.
And when God is no longer at the center, everything else begins to drift.
📖 How to Put God at the Center of Your Marriage
This isn't another relationship book filled with motivational quotes.
It's a biblical guide that will help you build a marriage that can stand through trials, disagreements, disappointments, and life's storms—not by human strength, but by Christ as your foundation.
Whether you're newly married, celebrating decades together, or praying for restoration, this book points you back to God's design for marriage with practical, Scripture-based encouragement.
Inside you'll discover:
✅ How to make Jesus the true foundation of your relationship
✅ Simple ways to pray together consistently
✅ Biblical principles for forgiveness that heals wounded hearts
✅ How to communicate with grace instead of pride
✅ How to fight spiritual battles as one team—not against each other
✅ How to build a Christ-centered home that blesses future generations
🔥 Most people want a happier marriage.
Few are willing to build a holier marriage.
Most people ask God to fix their spouse.
Few ask God to first transform their own heart.
Most couples prepare for the wedding day.
Few prepare for a lifetime of faithfully walking with Christ together.
The strongest marriages aren't perfect.
They're surrendered to Jesus.
🎁 And more as our library continues to grow
🙏 JOIN THE MOVEMENT
This is more than downloading another book.
It's about raising Christ-centered marriages.
Strengthening Christian families.
Passing faith to the next generation.
And making Jesus the center of every home.
If that's the kind of movement you want to be part of...
